climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune village in Burgundy, making red from Pinot Noir and white from Chardonnay. Its vineyards sit in a side valley west of Auxey-Duresses, toward the Hautes Côtes de Beaune, rather than on the main slope.
